summary: Appear ASA develops and provides solutions for processing, transport, and delivery of live video for the broadcast, media, and sports industries in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Americas, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers various software and platforms, such as VX platform, an open media technology software platform built for broadcast workflows; XC platform, a modular head-end solution for IPTV and broadcast distribution that supports distribution across cable, satellite, terrestrial networks, and hospitality applications; and X platform, which offers media processing and gateway hardware platform. It also provides customer support and technology development services. The company serves sports leagues and federations, broadcasters and streaming platforms, production service providers, and connectivity providers. Appear ASA was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Oslo, Norway.
